text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA said its net loss in 1996 amounted to 53.9 million zlotys against the earlier reported 39.5 million due to financial restructuring at the firm, Swarzedz said in a statement.

The company said in a Thursday statement that it was likely to show a 4.4-million-zloty net loss in 1997 because of its high financial costs but said its sales should rise 63.7 percent to 167.9 million zlotys, as it had forecast earlier.
It said the 1996 results revision should not influence the company's group results, scheduled for publishing on July 22.
Swarzedz has a debt of 63 million zlotys, half of which will be paid off with shares.
It plans to issue 3.125 million shares to creditors in the third quarter and to offer current shareholders another 3.5 million shares.
